'''2008 World Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed World Championship, 10–12 October 2008, in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The constructed pool was [[Premiere - Original VS16]]. [[Kevin Shannon]] defeated [[Kyle Krueger]] in the final.<ref name="hof">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Awards and Hall of Fame], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125358/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/awards.html Internet Archive]</ref> Published lists are the Day 1–3 and Team PDFs on the Players Committee decklist desk.<ref name="tdl">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2008-decklists/ 2008 Decklists], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013152223/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2008-decklists.html Internet Archive]</ref> Dates on the sheets are 10 October 2008 (Day 1), 11 October 2008 (Day 2), and 12 October 2008 (Day 3).


== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Site:''' Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Dates:''' 10–12 October 2008
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]

=== Top 8 bracket ===

A 2020 forum post quoting an earlier player compilation gives this Day 3 bracket (seeds in brackets).<ref name="f75427-1300387">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1300387#p1300387 Post by Yoshi], "SWCCG Worlds Day 3 Standings History", forum.starwarsccg.org (28 May 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012152200/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t75427.html#p1300387 Internet Archive]</ref>

* Quarterfinals: (8) [[Kyle Krueger]] def. (1) [[Tom Frafjord]]; (2) [[Kevin Shannon]] def. (7) [[Jonny Chu]]; (6) [[Michael Raveling]] def. (3) [[Brian Hunter]]; (4) [[Steve Baroni]] def. (5) [[Garrett Larson]]
* Semifinals: Kyle Krueger def. Steve Baroni; Kevin Shannon def. Michael Raveling
* Final: Kevin Shannon def. Kyle Krueger
